Right is a red circle (high certainty) with low recoverability.
Lower is a green square and is currently the focus of attention; it is also the most recoverable now, though its recoverability declines over one and two steps.
Left is a blue cross (high certainty) with low recoverability.
My command model predicts that issuing a command to select a particular location will shift predicted attention to that same location, so I can reliably redirect selection among these four locations.
Note that changing selection does not by itself change the recoverability values in this record.

a yellow triangle at right (color skewed to yellow)
a green square at lower, and a red circle at left; the lower green square is currently and most strongly selected and most recoverable now, with recoverability falling over subsequent steps.
My command model predicts nearly all selection commands will route attention to the right location, so I cannot reliably redirect predicted selection away from right.
Redirecting selection per command does not imply improved recoverability.
